items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Tillman, was playing trumpet, Took, was playing piano, and who else was playing? Sun Wat, was playing John.

ctx.x: He comes... Yeah, do half a Spanish after phone up there. Yes. At the Patsila. He says, So, the next couple days, before they all call my house, He says, Ruff, I say, what? He says, He has... He has chance on me, man, for eight o'clock. I say, okay. Dollar a night. I say, how many fish you got? He said, He said, This me and you and, uh... Uh... Who's coming here? I'm a woman like that. This me and you and I remember that. And, uh... Me and you remember that? And, uh... Son of White. Summer. Well, that's amazing.…

items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Yeah. That's—that's—now that's—that's one mistake they made in my life. ... T-Boy was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Did you ever know a saxophone player named T-Boy? T-Boy?

Yeah. That's—that's—now that's—that's one mistake they made in my life. Mm-hmm. That's why I'm asking you. I mean—yeah, yeah, yeah. Excuse me. Why I had that flu, man. Uh, T-Boy was a trumpet player. Mm-hmm.
